en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Abu Al Hassan Al Rezaasws, said,
‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[9:119] O you who believe! Fear Allah and be with the truthful ones.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The truthful ones, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, and the very truthful in their<sup>asws</sup> obedience (is in obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr who has said that he asked abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.)
about the meaning of the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, in the following verse.
“Believers, be pious before God and always be friends with the truthful ones.” [9:119]
The Imams (a.s.) said, “The truthful ones are the Imams (a.s.) who, are truthful in their obedience (to Allah).”
